title: Creation and the Fall, part 1 of 3: The Six Days
style: Classical oil painting on canvas, visible expressive brushstrokes and palette-knife texture, dramatic chiaroscuro, rich earthy palette of ochre, umber, olive and deep blue. The primeval world at its creation: untouched wilderness, no buildings, no tools, no man-made objects of any kind. Cinematic 16:9 landscape composition. No text, no borders, no watermark, no modern objects.

blocks.DARK: Almost total darkness: the scene is barely visible, painted in black, deep indigo and cold blue-grey, with no light source of any kind. No sun, no moon, no stars, no glow on the horizon, no land, no living thing
blocks.NOSUN: The light is soft, even and sourceless, glowing through the whole sky at once. There is no sun, no moon and no stars anywhere in the picture: no sun disk, no bright spot in the sky, no rays from a single point
blocks.NOLIFE: No animals, no birds, no fish, no people anywhere
blocks.BARE: The land is completely bare wet rock, sand and dark soil with no plants, no grass and no trees
blocks.NOBEAST: No land animals and no people anywhere
blocks.PEACE: All the animals are calm and at peace with one another: none hunts, fights, bares its teeth or flees
blocks.PAIR: the first man and the first woman, both with warm brown skin and dark hair, his hair short and hers falling long down her back, seen from behind at a distance, standing hip-deep in tall grass and flowering shrubs and strongly backlit so that they are near-silhouettes. They wear no clothing at all: no cloth, no wrap, no skirt, no loincloth; only their bare shoulders and backs show above the tall grass, which alone covers them from the hips down. Modest framing, no nudity visible
blocks.GLORY: a vast radiance of pure golden-white light pouring down from above the frame, with no figure, no face and no human shape in the light

segs.text: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
Now the earth was formless and void, and darkness was over the surface of the deep. And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters.
And God said,
Let there be light,
and there was light.
And God saw that the light was good, and He separated the light from the darkness.
God called the light “day,” and the darkness He called “night.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the first day.
And God said,
Let there be an expanse between the waters, to separate the waters from the waters.
So God made the expanse and separated the waters beneath it from the waters above. And it was so.
God called the expanse “sky.” And there was evening, and there was morning—the second day.
And God said,
Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place, so that the dry land may appear.
And it was so.
God called the dry land “earth,” and the gathering of waters He called “seas.” And God saw that it was good.
Then God said,
Let the earth bring forth vegetation: seed-bearing plants and fruit trees, each bearing fruit with seed according to its kind.
And it was so.
The earth produced vegetation: seed-bearing plants according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed according to their kinds. And God saw that it was good.
And there was evening, and there was morning—the third day.
And God said,

Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night, and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years. And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth.
And it was so.
God made two great lights: the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night. And He made the stars as well.
God set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth,
to preside over the day and the night, and to separate the light from the darkness. And God saw that it was good.
And there was evening, and there was morning—the fourth day.
And God said,
Let the waters teem with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.
So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves, with which the waters teemed according to their kinds, and every bird of flight after its kind. And God saw that it was good.
Then God blessed them and said,
Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.
And there was evening, and there was morning—the fifth day.
And God said,
Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds: livestock, land crawlers, and beasts of the earth according to their kinds.
And it was so.
God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, the livestock according to their kinds, and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind. And God saw that it was good.
Then God said,
Let Us make man in Our image, after Our likeness, to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air, over the livestock, and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it.
So God created man in His own image; in the image of God He created him; male and female He created them.
God blessed them and said to them,
Be fruitful and multiply, and fill the earth and subdue it; rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth.
Then God said,

Behold, I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth, and every tree whose fruit contains seed. They will be yours for food. And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth—everything that has the breath of life in it—I have given every green plant for food.
And it was so.
And God looked upon all that He had made, and indeed, it was very good. And there was evening, and there was morning—the sixth day.

stills.prompt: A vast dark void. In the centre, barely distinguishable from the blackness, hangs the dim shape of a shapeless world wrapped in dark water and vapour. {DARK}. Very wide view.
An endless black ocean under a black sky, formless and empty, heavy swells rolling into nothing, the horizon lost in darkness. {DARK}. Wide low view just above the water.
Close view of the surface of a deep black sea: slow oily swells and a plunging trough, the water bottomless beneath. {DARK}. Close framing, the water fills the whole picture.

A great wind moves low across an endless black ocean, pressing long furrows into the water and lifting veils of fine spray that hover above the surface like a breath. No figure, no bird, no shape in the wind. {DARK}. Wide view along the furrowed water.

Total darkness over a black ocean, split by a single thin horizontal blade of pure white-gold light opening across the middle of the picture, its first gleam touching the wave tops. The light comes from no sun: there is no sun disk, no moon and no stars. No land, no living thing. Wide view.

Brilliant light bursts across a dark ocean and floods the whole sky, driving back the blackness in great billowing waves of gold and white radiance. The waves below blaze with reflected light. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}. Very wide view.
A calm endless ocean shining under a sky full of gentle golden light, every ripple glittering, the air clear and luminous. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}. Wide serene view.

An endless ocean under a sky divided in two: the left half filled with luminous golden light, the right half deep darkness, a clean curving boundary between them running down to the water. Bright water under the light, black water under the dark. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}. Wide symmetrical view.
Day: bright even daylight over an endless blue-green ocean, the whole sky a glowing pale gold and white. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}. Wide view from just above the waves.
Night: deep darkness over an endless ocean, the water a faint indigo sheen under a black sky that is completely empty. No moon, no stars, no sun, no glow. No land. {NOLIFE}. Wide quiet view.
The first morning: darkness lifting off an endless ocean as soft pearl and rose light spreads evenly up the whole sky from the horizon. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}. Wide view.

Water everywhere with no sky: an endless sea whose surface dissolves upward into dense rolling walls of mist, rain and vapour, so that there is no horizon and no open air, only waters below merging with waters above. Dim even daylight. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}.

A widening band of clear open air forces its way between a heaving sea below and an immense ceiling of water-laden vapour above, the two masses of water being pushed apart from each other. Daylight fills the gap. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}. Wide view looking along the opening gap.

Looking upward from just above the sea: enormous towering masses of water-heavy cloud are being lifted high overhead, streaming with mist, while the sea falls away below, and clear bright air opens between them. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}. Low angle looking up.

A vast clear expanse of open air stretching between a calm endless sea below and a high vaulted canopy of luminous cloud above. The two are completely separated. {NOSUN}. No land. {NOLIFE}. Very wide, deep view.

Sky: a high clear vault of blue arching over an endless ocean, with thin luminous clouds at its top. The blue is evenly lit and empty: no sun disk, no moon, no stars, no birds. No land. {NOLIFE}. Low view tilted up into the vault of the sky.

Evening passing into morning over an endless ocean beneath a high open sky: violet dusk on one side of the sky and soft pearl dawn glow on the other. No sun disk, no moon, no stars. No land. {NOLIFE}. Wide view.

A worldwide ocean in motion: immense currents and foaming rivers of seawater rushing in one direction, draining away and gathering together under an open blue sky. {NOSUN}. {NOLIFE}. High wide view over the racing water.

Dry land appears: a great dark ridge of rock heaves up out of the sea, sheets of white water cascading off its flanks as the waters pull back from it. {BARE}. {NOSUN}. {NOLIFE}. Wide dramatic view from sea level.

A broad new shore of wet glistening sand, mud and rock lies exposed as the sea withdraws from it, shallow channels of water running back toward the retreating waves. {BARE}. {NOSUN}. {NOLIFE}. Medium-wide view along the shore.

Earth: a wide sweep of newly risen land, bare brown and red hills, valleys and distant mountains of naked rock and soil drying in the daylight under an open sky. {BARE}. {NOSUN}. {NOLIFE}. High wide view over the land.
Seas: deep blue-green waves break in white surf against a bare rocky coast, the gathered sea stretching to the horizon beside the dry land. {BARE}. {NOSUN}. {NOLIFE}. Wide view along the coastline.

Close view of dark bare soil cracking open as the very first tender green shoots push up out of the ground, a few tiny seedlings unfurling their first leaves, beads of water on the earth. Soft even daylight. No animals, no insects, no people. Close-up at ground level.

A wave of fresh green spreading across bare brown hills and valleys: new grass, young plants and saplings covering the ground, half the land already green and half still bare soil. {NOSUN}. {NOLIFE}. High wide view.

Close view of seed-bearing plants: ripe heads of wild wheat and barley heavy with grain, tall grasses in seed and seed pods splitting open, swaying in a meadow. Soft even daylight. No insects, no birds, no animals, no people. Close framing among the stalks.

Close view of the branches of fruit trees heavy with ripe fruit: figs, olives and red pomegranates, one pomegranate split open on the branch showing its glistening seeds. Soft even daylight filtering through the leaves. No insects, no birds, no animals, no people, no hands. Close framing.
A lush green valley of meadows, flowering plants and groves of fruit trees running down to a blue sea, hills clothed in forest behind. {NOSUN}. {NOLIFE}. Wide, serene view from a hillside.

Evening on the third day: a green wooded shoreline and calm sea in deep violet dusk, the sky dimming evenly from rose to dark blue. The sky is empty: no sun, no moon, no stars. {NOLIFE}. Wide quiet view.

Above a dark green wooded land and sea, the dim empty vault of the sky begins to kindle: the first few points of light and a gathering golden glow appear high in the expanse. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Low view tilted up into the sky.
A slender crescent moon and a scatter of bright stars in a deep blue twilight sky above forested hills and a still lake that mirrors them. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Wide tranquil view.

Day meeting night across one wide sky: on the left a low golden sun over green hills, on the right deep blue night with a pale moon and stars, the colours blending overhead above a broad wooded valley. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Very wide panoramic view.

Warm shafts of sunlight pour down through parting clouds onto green hills, meadows and fruit groves, lighting the earth in gold with long soft shadows. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Wide view across the sunlit land.

The greater light: a blazing golden sun rising over the sea beside a green forested coast, its path of fire across the water and the whole sky ablaze with morning. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Wide view facing the sunrise.
The lesser light: a large full moon hanging over dark forested hills and a silver river at night, its cool light edging the treetops. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Wide night view.

The stars: a clear night sky crowded with countless stars and the glowing band of the Milky Way arching over a dark silhouette of hills and trees. No moon in this view. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Low view looking up.

View from a high mountainside across a great green land of forests, rivers and plains running to the sea, the sun set high in a blue sky and shining down upon the earth. {NOBEAST}, no birds. High, very wide view.

Sunset over a wooded coast: the sun half below the sea horizon in bands of orange and crimson, while behind the dark trees on the other side of the sky the night gathers deep blue. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Wide view.
A calm sea at night with a long silver path of moonlight on the water leading to a bright moon, stars above, a dark wooded headland at one side. {NOBEAST}, no birds, no fish. Wide serene view.
Dawn: the last stars fading in a pale sky as the rim of the sun breaks over green hills, mist lying in the valleys and the first light catching the treetops. {NOBEAST}, no birds. Wide view.

Underwater view in clear blue-green sea: great shoals of silver fish swirl up from the depths through slanting shafts of sunlight, the water suddenly teeming with life. No people. Wide underwater view looking up toward the bright surface.

A great flock of birds bursts upward from the sea's edge and wheels across the open sky above the waves and a green shore: white gulls, cranes and doves with wings spread. {NOBEAST}. Wide low view looking up at the rising flock.

The great sea creatures: an enormous whale breaches from the ocean in an explosion of white spray while other whales blow spouts nearby, a green coast in the far distance. {NOBEAST}. Wide dramatic view at sea level.

Underwater scene teeming with living things of many kinds: sea turtles, rays, bright reef fish, jellyfish, an octopus among corals, and the huge shadowy form of a whale passing behind. Shafts of sunlight from above. No people. Wide underwater view.

Birds of many kinds in flight over a green river valley: an eagle soaring, storks and cranes in a line, swallows darting, doves and bright small songbirds, each kind distinct. {NOBEAST}. Wide airy view among the birds.
Dolphins leap through sunlit waves while pelicans glide low over the water beside them, golden light on sea and sky. {NOBEAST}. Medium view close to the water.

A golden radiance pours down from above through clear sea water onto an immense spiralling school of fish that fills the sea, thousands upon thousands, with small young fish among them. No figure and no face in the light. No people. Underwater view looking up.

Birds multiplying on the earth: close view of a nest in the fork of a fruit tree with a dove sitting beside a clutch of eggs and newly hatched chicks, other nests and birds visible in the branches behind. {NOBEAST}. Close framing.
Evening on the fifth day: long skeins of birds fly in silhouette across an orange and violet sunset sky above a calm sea where distant whales send up spouts. {NOBEAST}. Wide view.

Morning mist lifting from a green plain to reveal living creatures of many kinds coming forth across the land: deer, wild oxen, horses and gazelles emerging from the mist and the trees. Birds overhead. {PEACE}. {NOMAN}. Wide view across the plain.
Livestock: a mixed herd of sheep, goats and cattle grazing with their young on a sunlit green hillside beside a stream. No fences, no shepherd, no buildings. {NOMAN}. Medium-wide view.

The beasts of the earth: a lion with a full mane resting in the grass, elephants walking behind, a bear, deer and a leopard all sharing the same sunlit woodland clearing. {PEACE}. {NOMAN}. Wide view across the clearing.

Livestock at a river: cattle, donkeys, camels and goats drinking side by side at the edge of clear water under palm and fruit trees. No ropes, no saddles, no fences, no buildings. {NOMAN}. Medium view from across the water.

Everything that crawls upon the earth: close ground-level view of a forest floor where a tortoise, a green lizard on a stone, a snail, beetles and a line of ants move among leaves, moss and fallen fruit. {NOMAN}. Close-up.

A vast green valley full of animals of every kind in sunlight: herds on the plain, elephants and giraffes by the trees, flocks of birds over a winding river, the sea beyond. {PEACE}. {NOMAN}. Very wide high view.
Above a green valley filled with resting animals, the sky opens and {GLORY}, flooding the valley. The animals are still. {NOMAN}. Wide view looking up the valley toward the light.

The fish of the sea and the birds of the air in one view: the picture split at the waterline, shoals of fish and a sea turtle below the surface, gulls and an eagle in the bright sky above, a green shore in the distance. {NOMAN}. Half-underwater view.

Cattle and sheep on a green slope with the whole earth spread out behind them: plains, forests, rivers and far mountains under a great sky. Small creatures, a lizard and a tortoise, on rocks in the foreground. {NOMAN}. Wide deep view.

An empty sunlit clearing in a garden of fruit trees and flowers, a single great shaft of golden-white light falling from above onto the grass at its centre. Animals watch quietly from the edge of the trees. No figure and no face in the light. {NOMAN}. Medium-wide view.

The first man, newly created, stands in the centre of a garden clearing in a blaze of golden-white light from above. He is seen from behind at a distance as a dark near-silhouette against the light: only his head, with short dark curly hair, and his bare brown shoulders rise above very tall grass and wildflowers, which hide everything below his shoulders. No garment, collar or sleeve is visible on him. His head is lifted toward the light. No figure and no face in the light. Deer watch from the trees. Wide view.

A garden clearing ringed by fruit trees and flooded with a great golden light from beyond the trees. Far off in the middle of the clearing, seen from behind, a man and a woman stand side by side looking toward the light, small in the frame, dark silhouettes against the glow: only their heads and bare shoulders rise above very tall grass and wildflowers, which hide everything below their shoulders; his hair short, dark and curly, hers long and dark down her back. Exactly two people. Very wide view from behind them.
{PAIR}, small in the frame beneath {GLORY} that falls over them and over the whole green valley beyond, where herds graze. Exactly two people. Very wide view from behind them.

Close view of a man's brown hand resting gently on the mane of a calm lion lying in the grass beside a lamb. Only the hand and forearm of the man are in the frame; his face and body are out of frame. The lion is peaceful, eyes half closed. Close framing.

Close view of a woman's brown hand and forearm held out as a dove alights on her fingers, and below, her ankles standing in a clear stream where small fish swim around her feet. Her face and body are out of frame. Sunlit garden behind. Close framing.

Close view of a man's brown hand reaching up to pick a ripe fig from a laden branch among green leaves, sunlight through the foliage. Only the hand and forearm are in the frame; no face, no body. Close framing.

Close view of two cupped brown hands holding ripe heads of wheat and loose grain, seeds spilling between the fingers, a golden field of seed-bearing plants behind. Only the hands are in the frame; no face, no body. Close framing.

Beneath the spreading boughs of a great fruit tree hung with red pomegranates and purple figs, the first man and the first woman stand seen from behind at a distance, the man's bare arm reaching up to a low branch. They are dark near-silhouettes against the light: only their heads and bare brown shoulders rise above very tall grass and wildflowers, which hide everything below their shoulders; his hair short, dark and curly, hers long and dark down her back. No garment is visible on them. Exactly two people. This is an ordinary fruit tree in an orchard of many fruit trees; there is no serpent anywhere. Wide view from behind them.

Close view of a man's brown hand and bare forearm reaching up from the bottom of the frame to pick a ripe purple fig from a low leafy branch heavy with figs, sunlit leaves all around and more fruit trees soft in the background. Only the hand and forearm are in the frame; no face, no body, no sleeve, no bracelet. This is an ordinary fruit tree in an orchard of many fruit trees; there is no serpent anywhere. Close framing.

Beasts of the earth eating green plants: a lion and an ox side by side with their heads lowered to the grass, a bear eating berries from a bush, deer grazing behind them. {PEACE}. {NOMAN}. Medium-wide view in a sunlit meadow.
Birds of the air feeding on plants: small bright songbirds and doves perched on swaying seed heads and berry branches, pecking at seeds and berries. {NOMAN}. Close view.

Creatures that crawl upon the earth feeding on green plants: close ground-level view of a tortoise biting a broad green leaf, a caterpillar on a stem and a snail on a wet leaf beside it. {NOMAN}. Close-up.

The whole creation in one great view, flooded with golden light from above: mountains, forests, a winding river, the sea, herds on the plains, flocks in the sky. In the foreground on a hilltop, seen from behind, the first man and the first woman look out over it all as small dark near-silhouettes: only their heads and bare brown shoulders rise above very tall grass and wildflowers, which hide everything below their shoulders; his hair short, dark and curly, hers long and dark down her back. No garment is visible on them. Exactly two people. No figure and no face in the light. Very wide high view.

{PAIR}, sitting together on a grassy hilltop watching the sun go down over a valley where animals settle for the night, a lion and lambs lying near them. Exactly two people. Wide view from behind them.

Night passing into morning on the sixth day: a sleeping green valley with resting herds under a sky still full of stars on one side while the first gold of sunrise breaks over the hills on the other. No people in view. Very wide view.

card_notes: Every spoken word is Scripture: Genesis 1:1–31, complete.
notes: Text: Genesis 1:1-31 in full, no verses skipped or abridged. Speaker G is the voice of God (words inside the quotation marks); N is the narrator. Quotation marks in v5, v8, v10 are names, read by the narrator.
Still tags: T = from the text, I = inferred, D = dramatized.

Order of events is kept strictly: no light before v3 (A stills are near-black); no sun, moon or stars before day four (B, C, D stills use sourceless light); no land before v9; no plants before v11; no animals before day five; no land animals before day six; no people before v27.

D: A1 pictures "the heavens and the earth" of v1 as a dim water-wrapped mass in darkness. D: A4 pictures the Spirit of God hovering as wind and hovering spray over the waters, with no figure. D: H4 an empty lit clearing before the creation of man.
I: C1-C4 picture the expanse as clear air opening between the sea and cloud-borne waters above. I: E3 day and night in one sky for "to distinguish between the day and the night".
God is shown only as light and voice. "Let Us make man" (v26) is shown as light, with no figure.

The man and the woman have no reference sheets in this unit: they appear only from behind, at a distance, backlit, or as hands, so that the Genesis 2-3 units can set their faces. Nudity is hidden by foliage, distance and backlight (PIPELINE default).
v29-30: every creature is given green plants for food, so no predation is shown anywhere in this unit.

Review: rejected takes with land before v9 (C5), a sun-like bright spot before day four (B1, B2, C3, C6), the pair or the man in clothing (H5 first pass, H6, H7, I3, I7 first pass, I8), a sleeve on the arm (H8), a hewn-looking stone (G5) and a modern-looking black-and-white cow (G2). H5 and I7 were regenerated shoulder-deep in grass.
God's voice (bm_george, lowered) is a placeholder chosen without hearing it; narration is not generated in this unit.
I3 (the pair beneath the fruit tree) keeps no clip: the video model refused it twice (content moderation). It stays as a still; I10 (a hand picking a fig, v29) carries the motion for that moment.
